svg.text: talk.01 · ROUND 5 · EIGHT RETRO PUSH-TO-TALK DEVICES
each starts from one real kind of old device · grilles are lines, slots or dot-matrix · panels are colour-blocked
TENTATIVE · NOT A FINAL DESIGN
original concepts · same scale in every card (10 mm = 40 px)
all: USB-C on top · small hatch, no full-back cover · three-stage PTT
These are not variations of one shape. Pick the ones that feel right; ignore the rest.
1 · TPS
Walkman colour blocks
lineage: Sony Walkman TPS-L2 (blue body, silver strip,
orange hold slider)
grille: vertical slots panels: blue / silver / orange
lever: orange wedge in the silver strip cable: black
coil
+ the clearest TE-style colour-blocking + HOLD slider =
LOCK
stand: small U on the back; cover: small hatch
- the silver strip needs real metal or paint to sell it
2 · WAND
toy voice gadget
lineage: Texas Instruments Magic Wand (blue toy, red tip,
same-colour cable)
grille: round dot-matrix speaker disc panels: blue / red
/ white
lever: red wand tip cable: same blue as the body
+ the most playful; 4 colour LEDs show the mode + hand-
strap hole
stand: a flat foot (a round body would roll); cover: small
hatch
- the most toy-like; the least 'serious tool'
3 · CUBE
wood and brass
lineage: 1960s transistor radios (a walnut cube with a
perforated front, a gold dial)
grille: dot-matrix perforations materials: wood, brass,
black
lever: black slanted bar cable: black coil
+ warm and unusual; wood filament or veneer is printable
stand: a small brass-look U; cover: small hatch
- wood grain must look real; brass is paint or a printed
plate
4 · TUNER
transistor radio
lineage: a 1960s transistor radio (silver case, black
panel, cream tuning scale)
grille: vertical slots panels: silver / black / cream /
gold
mode: a scale with a red needle (DICT TALK OPEN LOCK)
cable: black
+ the scale shows the mode like a real tuner + gold lamp
badge
stand: the battery-door style hatch swings out as the
stand
- the needle needs a mechanism (a thumb knob and a slider)
military hand radio
lineage: a WWII-to-1960s hand radio (olive hammertone,
data plate, wing screws)
grille: round dot-matrix disc panels: olive / cream
plate / black
lever: wide ribbed PTT bar mode: a ribbed knob with 1-4
cable: olive-black
+ the most 'real radio'; a printed data plate is a joke
and a label
stand: a fold-out bail with the strap loop; cover: small
hatch
- heavy, serious look; texture needs a spray finish
6 · PAGEBOY
pager
lineage: a 1980s pager (black, chrome trim, a belt clip)
grille: horizontal lines panels: black / chrome / amber
lever: slim chrome bar mode: a small slide switch
cable: black coil
+ small and pocketable; the chrome clip can be the stand
stand: the chrome belt clip is the stand; cover: small
hatch
- tiny; the lever and board need a tight fit
7 · GAMEBOY
90s handheld
lineage: an early handheld console (grey body, blue-grey
bezel, magenta buttons)
grille: a 'screen' made of horizontal lines panels: grey
/ blue-grey / magenta
PTT: a big round TALK button on the thumb side cable:
grey coil
+ instantly friendly; the line-grille 'screen' is a good
joke
stand: a battery-door hatch that is the stand
- the iconic layout: keep it an abstract nod
8 · RECORDER
tape deck and dictation
lineage: a tape recorder (black, brushed metal, a dial,
piano keys)
grille: horizontal lines panels: black / metal / cream
dial / red
PTT: a big latching key mode: a dial with a needle
cable: black coil
+ the key stays down when latched (visible state)
stand: small U; cover: small hatch
- a latching key is a harder mechanism
